en: Added `/advisor` on Claude Platform on AWS; no advisor runs until you pick one with `/advisor`, `advisorModel` or `--advisor`, and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL=1` turns it off
zh: 在 Claude Platform on AWS 上新增 `/advisor`；在你通过 `/advisor`、`advisorModel` 或 `--advisor` 选定之前不会运行 advisor，设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL=1` 可将其关闭
